function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verify the customer's identity before any sensitive account or debt information is disclosed. Requires account ID and the verification value provided by the customer.

verification_code.description: Verification value supplied by the customer, such as the last 4 digits of PAN or DOB year.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Retrieve account and overdue details only after successful customer verification.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Record an explicitly confirmed Promise-to-Pay. The amount must match the authoritative overdue amount returned by the account-details tool.

amount.description: Confirmed PTP amount in Indian Rupees.

ptp_date.description: Confirmed payment date, preferably in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Send a mock payment link after successful authentication, account retrieval, and a successfully logged PTP.

channel.description: Channel used to deliver the payment link.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Record the final outcome of the collections call.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalate a verified collections case to a human agent when human review is required, such as a dispute, hardship, already-paid reconciliation, or other supported escalation.

reason.description: Reason for human escalation, e.g. DISPUTE, HARDSHIP, or ALREADY_PAID.
